exclusion_reason: The publish path is the same generic database engine whose export is a byte-stable canonical serialization of the admitted rows in title order, with every row carrying title, build hash, environment, browser, revision, and backing evidence. The benchmark stays red because a real row needs a real recorded run and rating (BPTK-010) that do not exist, so the published export carries no real title.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the export is byte-stable across regeneration and every row resolves to evidence with no unbacked or personal-data row.
active_gate_evidence: The database suite covers the byte-stable export equal across two builds of the same rows, the full evidence-chain row fields, and the refusal of every unbacked, stale, or personal row.
procedure: Generate the export twice from the same evidence and compare bytes.
Assert every row carries the declared evidence field.
Attempt an unbacked and a personal-data row and assert refusal.
pass_criterion: No unbacked or personal row is accepted.
